sloka: योजनानि चतुः षष्टिः वराहो नाम पर्वतः ।सुवर्ण शृंगः सुमहान् अगाधे वरुण आलये ॥४-४२-३०॥
transliteration: yojanāni catuḥ ṣaṣṭiḥ varāho nāma parvataḥ ।suvarṇa śṛṁgaḥ sumahān agādhe varuṇa ālaye ॥4-42-30॥

translations.english: 'Plunge deep down into the sea and you will see a goldenpeaked mountain called Varaha, the residence of Varuna.It is extended over sixty four yojanas in the sea.
